description: Capability for every window the app opens. Tauri v2 resolves plugin IPC per window LABEL: a label matched by no capability here gets ZERO plugin/core permissions, so `listen`, `setSize`, `openUrl` and the titlebar drag region all fail inside it. Adding an AppWindow variant means adding its label here AND to `AppWindow::ALL`, which windows::tests::every_app_window_label_is_covered_by_a_capability then checks. Covering a label is necessary but not sufficient: the command the window calls must also be in the permission list below. core:window:default carries allow-inner-size (the getter) but not allow-set-size, which the update window needs to fit itself to its release notes.
